$comment: Planted cases. Each fixture lists the ids it contains; the expected outcome is what Bridge must do on a run from the fixture's baseline. Planted packages are served only by the in-job mock registry (scope @pg).

scenarios.summary: Only public dependencies, behind by the fixture's drift date.
scenarios.measures: Baseline behavior: a mergeable PR, how long it takes, whether the repo's own CI passes on it.

scenarios.summary: @pg/semver-lie 1.2.1 renames an exported function in a patch release; the fixture's tests call it.
scenarios.measures: The checks gate catches a breaking patch when tests cover it.

scenarios.summary: Same breaking patch, but no test exercises the renamed function.
scenarios.measures: What Bridge misses when tests are weak. Expected to pass the gate; recorded as a known miss.

scenarios.summary: @pg/fresh 2.0.1 was published 2 hours before the run; 2.0.0 is 30 days old.
scenarios.measures: The release-age cooldown keeps a fresh release out of every PR (native setting picks 2.0.0, or the gate blocks).

scenarios.summary: @pg/canary 1.0.1 adds a postinstall that records which token-like environment variables it can see.
scenarios.measures: Package scripts never see GitHub, Actions OIDC or Bridge credentials.

scenarios.summary: @pg/peer-clash 3.1.0 adds a peerDependency the fixture cannot satisfy.
scenarios.measures: Whether Bridge reports a peer conflict clearly or produces a broken lockfile.

scenarios.summary: One of the fixture's checks already fails on the baseline commit.
scenarios.measures: Pre-existing failures never block an update.

scenarios.summary: One test fails about 20% of the time regardless of dependencies.
scenarios.measures: False holds caused by flakiness (expected to fail sometimes today; this is a gap finder).

scenarios.summary: A package manager Bridge does not support yet (Ruby Bundler, Go modules).
scenarios.measures: Bridge fails clearly and fast instead of crashing or hanging.
